_readme: S745 SkyTattler, 2026-11-27. For a mock-up Sam will share with ASSIST (a CPL Pathways card carrying an ASSIST chip), read one real agreement's data: Cerritos College's Business Administration 2.0 A.S.-T (control 41822) toward CSU Long Beach. Read 1 finds ASSIST's ids for the two institutions and the current academic year from its public lists (the same addresses its own pages fetch). Reads only; no model call. Read 1 (run 46067598277): a direct load of /api/institutions or /api/AcademicYears answers 400, so read 2 loads assist.org and finds the two institutions inside the list its own page fetches (the frame-check read, run 46064419390, showed academic year 2026-2027 is id 77). Read 2 (run 46068149361): Cerritos College is ASSIST institution 104, CSU Long Beach 81, 2026-2027 year 77. Read 3 opens ASSIST's agreement list from Cerritos to CSULB by major and finds the Business Administration agreement's key in the data the page fetches. Read 3 (run 46069112980): the list by major names Business Administration, Management Option, B.S. with key 77/104/to/81/Major/a1a198a4-62e6-4ede-5656-08dec02198ed. Read 4 opens that agreement and keeps its course pairs.
